candidate_query:
MATCH (rel:Release)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rel)<-[:TARGET_RELEASE]-(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' AND NOT sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.591'
RETURN rel.releaseName AS releaseName, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specNumbers
ORDER BY releaseName ASC
